summary.en: A beautifully made open-source Sudoku with difficulty tiers, pencil marks, a timer and mistake checking.
summary.zh: 界面精良的开源数独，带难度分级、笔记、计时与自动校验。

description.en: Fill the 9×9 grid so every row, column and 3×3 box holds the digits 1-9 exactly once. Candidate notes, error hints, undo and restart all come standard.
description.zh: 9×9 棋盘填数，每行每列每宫 1-9 不重复。支持候选数笔记、错误提示、撤销与重开。

tip.en: Sudoku has some of the best retention in the puzzle genre — a natural home for a 'daily puzzle' column. The React components are cleanly organized, so wiring in your own accounts and leaderboards is painless.
tip.zh: 数独是留存率最高的一类益智游戏，适合做「每日一题」栏目。React 组件化结构清晰，接自己的用户系统、排行榜比较方便。
